migration_flags.note: Field does not exist on account.move.line in v19. Was a Many2one FK to account.analytic.account in v16 and earlier. Must be transformed into analytic_distribution JSON.
M2M field to account.analytic.tag does not exist on account.move.line in v19. Must be merged into analytic_distribution JSON structure.

JSON field via analytic.mixin. Keys are comma-separated analytic account IDs (strings), values are percentage floats. Example: {"123": 60.0, "456,789": 40.0}. Must sum to 100 per plan when analytic plans require mandatory allocation.

In v19, balance is the stored primary field. debit and credit are computed from balance. Bulk migration writes should target balance directly. debit = max(balance,0), credit = max(-balance,0) when is_storno=False.
tax_line_id is a related-stored field derived from tax_repartition_line_id.tax_id. Do not write tax_line_id directly; write tax_repartition_line_id instead.
move_type on account.move.line is a non-stored related field to move_id.move_type. It is NOT in the account_move_line DB table. Domain filters using move_type will JOIN to account_move.

key_findings.debit_credit_model: balance is stored master (Monetary, company currency, tracking=True); debit and credit are computed — debit = balance if balance > 0 else 0, credit = -balance if balance < 0 else 0. DB constraint enforces credit * debit = 0.
key_findings.amount_currency: amount_currency stored in line currency (currency_id). Sign must match balance. When currency_id == company currency, amount_currency == balance enforced.
key_findings.reconciliation_flow: reconcile() -> _reconcile_plan([self]) -> _reconcile_plan_with_sync() -> creates account.partial.reconcile bulk, exchange diff moves, cash basis moves if needed, then account.full.reconcile when all lines fully matched.
key_findings.partial_reconcile_amounts: account.partial.reconcile.amount (company currency, always positive), debit_amount_currency (debit line currency, always positive), credit_amount_currency (credit line currency, always positive).
key_findings.full_reconcile_trigger: account.full.reconcile created when all amls in a matching group have zero residual in both company and foreign currency. Created via direct SQL INSERT for performance.
key_findings.matching_number: Char field: 'P<N>' for partial, '<N>' (decimal) for full (= full_reconcile_id), 'I<x>' for import-pending. DB constraint validates format regex ^((P?\d+)|(I.+))$.
key_findings.analytic_distribution_v19: JSON field via analytic.mixin. Replaces analytic_account_id (FK) and analytic_tag_ids (M2M) which are ABSENT in v19. Inverse triggers analytic line recreation on posted lines.
key_findings.tax_fields: tax_ids (M2M) on base/product lines; tax_repartition_line_id (M2O to account.tax.repartition.line) on tax amount lines; tax_line_id derived from repartition line; tax_base_amount stored in company currency.
key_findings.price_fields: price_subtotal and price_total computed via tax engine, expressed in invoice currency_id (not company currency). price_unit is computed from product pricelist, stored, writable.
key_findings.move_type_on_line: Non-stored related field to move_id.move_type. Not in DB table account_move_line.
key_findings.storno_accounting: is_storno=True inverts debit/credit computation. Controlled by company_id.account_storno. Applies to refunds when company storno is enabled.
key_findings.display_type: 13-value selection controlling line role. Section/subsection/note lines are exempt from accounting constraints. Tax lines have display_type='tax'. Payment term lines have display_type='payment_term'.
